verses.mystical_translation: The ruler comes home under shalom; the city holds its breath and prayer.
A seer's sharp wind cuts the court: loyalty to power cannot shelter enmity toward the Divine.
Removal of foreign shrines opens the heart to seeking the Name.
From the south to the highlands the king walks the people back into covenant.
Order is planted like watchtowers: law attends to each settled place.
Judgment is an encounter with the Presence; earthly office is a stewardship.
Fear of YHWH steadies the hand that must not bow to wealth or favor.
Religious offices are paired with judicial work; sacred memory accompanies legal truth.
The summons is both moral and inward: fidelity with a full heart.
Legal speech must guard covenantal life; the wording keeps open several legal senses.
Named leaders stand as faces of sanctuary and palace; courage is the covenantal charge.

contemplative_note: Righteous governance requires both prophetic accountability and concrete judicial structures; fear of YHWH is paired with procedural integrity.
safety_note: Contains legal/administrative authority material; not a justification for abuse of judicial power.
